about_the_game:
Game Introduction: Wanjie Sand City: Burning Soul of Battle

Wanjie Sand City: Burning Soul of Battle is a strategic combat game set in the world of Wanjie Sand City. The game integrates level design to deliver an immersive combat experience for players. Visually, it adopts a passionate and grand art style, paired with sand city-specific architectural elements (such as city walls and arrow towers), creating a unique visual atmosphere. In the game, players can not only enjoy intense and thrilling battles but also gradually enhance their strength through a variety of systems—including in-store shopping, army development, and battle strategy formulation. This allows them to write their own legendary legacy in the turbulent Wanjie Sand City.

Featured Systems

Daily Welfare

The game features a "Daily Check-In" system and a "Lottery" system. Daily Check-In provides players with a stable resource income, helping new players quickly accumulate materials. The Lottery system, filled with randomness, gives players the chance to obtain rare items, powerful military units, and other rewards—adding fun and a sense of surprise to the game.

Diverse Development

The bottom function bar includes options such as "Shop", "Army", "Battle", "Military Book", and "Construction".

  • The "Shop" allows players to purchase various items and resources;

  • The "Army" interface is used to manage and upgrade military units;

  • The "Military Book" system offers battle strategies and skill bonuses (e.g., "Sand City Tactical Notes" boosts army defense);

  • The "Construction" function involves sand city development (such as upgrading city walls and building resource workshops) to enhance the player’s overall strength.

These systems are interconnected, forming an in-depth development framework.

Interface & Operation

Interface Layout

The overall interface is concise:

  • The top clearly displays resource quantities and a game progress bar, allowing players to keep track of their status at any time;

  • The middle section highlights level information and key operation buttons, making it easy for players to quickly enter battles;

  • The bottom function bar is neatly organized, enabling players to switch between different function modules smoothly and conveniently.

Operation Experience

The game’s controls are simple and easy to understand, suitable for players of all ages. Whether new players are quickly mastering level battles or experienced players are making complex development adjustments and strategy tweaks, they can efficiently complete tasks through the concise interface—providing a solid gaming experience.

With its unique Wanjie Sand City setting, rich strategic gameplay, and user-friendly system design, Wanjie Sand City: Burning Soul of Battle immerses players in the joy of sand city domination. It encourages players to constantly challenge themselves and forge their own legacy of sand city supremacy.
